verses.arabicText: قُلْ أُوحِىَ إِلَىَّ أَنَّهُ ٱسْتَمَعَ نَفَرٌ مِّنَ ٱلْجِنِّ فَقَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّا سَمِعْنَا قُرْءَانًا عَجَبًا
verses.transliteration: Qul ūḥiya ilayya annahu is'tamaʿa nafarum-mina l-jini faqālū innā samiʿ'nā qur'ānan ʿajabā
verses.translation: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “It has been revealed to me that a group of jinn listened ˹to the Quran,˺ and said ˹to their fellow jinn˺: ‘Indeed, we have heard a wondrous recitation

verses.arabicText: يَهْدِىٓ إِلَى ٱلرُّشْدِ فَـَٔامَنَّا بِهِۦ ۖ وَلَن نُّشْرِكَ بِرَبِّنَآ أَحَدًا
verses.transliteration: Yahdī ilā r-rush'di faāmannā bihi walan-nush'rika birabbinā aḥadā
verses.translation: It leads to Right Guidance so we believed in it, and we will never associate anyone with our Lord ˹in worship˺

verses.arabicText: وَأَنَّهُۥ تَعَـٰلَىٰ جَدُّ رَبِّنَا مَا ٱتَّخَذَ صَـٰحِبَةً وَلَا وَلَدًا
verses.transliteration: Wa-annahu taʿālā jaddu rabbinā mā ittakhadha ṣāḥibataw-walā waladā
verses.translation: ˹Now, we believe that˺ our Lord—Exalted is His Majesty—has neither taken a mate nor offspring

verses.arabicText: وَأَنَّهُۥ كَانَ يَقُولُ سَفِيهُنَا عَلَى ٱللَّهِ شَطَطًا
verses.transliteration: Wa-annahu kāna yaqūlu safīhunā ʿalā l-lahi shaṭaṭā
verses.translation: and that the foolish of us used to utter ˹outrageous˺ falsehoods about Allah

verses.arabicText: وَأَنَّا ظَنَنَّآ أَن لَّن تَقُولَ ٱلْإِنسُ وَٱلْجِنُّ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ كَذِبًا
verses.transliteration: Wa-annā ẓanannā al-lan taqūla l-insu wal-jinu ʿalā l-lahi kadhibā
verses.translation: We certainly thought that humans and jinn would never speak lies about Allah

verses.arabicText: وَأَنَّهُۥ كَانَ رِجَالٌ مِّنَ ٱلْإِنسِ يَعُوذُونَ بِرِجَالٍ مِّنَ ٱلْجِنِّ فَزَادُوهُمْ رَهَقًا
verses.transliteration: Wa-annahu kāna rijālum-mina l-insi yaʿūdhūna birijālim-mina l-jini fazādūhum rahaqā
verses.translation: And some men used to seek refuge with some jinn—so they increased each other in wickedness

verses.arabicText: وَأَنَّهُمْ ظَنُّوا۟ كَمَا ظَنَنتُمْ أَن لَّن يَبْعَثَ ٱللَّهُ أَحَدًا
verses.transliteration: Wa-annahum ẓannū kamā ẓanantum al-lay-yabʿatha l-lahu aḥadā
verses.translation: And those ˹humans˺ thought, just like you ˹jinn˺, that Allah would not resurrect anyone ˹for judgment˺

verses.arabicText: وَأَنَّا لَمَسْنَا ٱلسَّمَآءَ فَوَجَدْنَـٰهَا مُلِئَتْ حَرَسًا شَدِيدًا وَشُهُبًا
verses.transliteration: Wa-annā lamasnā s-samāa fawajadnāhā muli-at ḥarasan shadīdaw-washuhubā
verses.translation: ˹Earlier˺ we tried to reach heaven ˹for news˺, only to find it filled with stern guards and shooting stars

verses.arabicText: وَأَنَّا كُنَّا نَقْعُدُ مِنْهَا مَقَـٰعِدَ لِلسَّمْعِ ۖ فَمَن يَسْتَمِعِ ٱلْـَٔانَ يَجِدْ لَهُۥ شِهَابًا رَّصَدًا
verses.transliteration: Wa-annā kunnā naqʿudu min'hā maqāʿida lilssamʿi famay-yastamiʿi l-āna yajid lahu shihābar-raṣadā
verses.translation: We used to take up positions there for eavesdropping, but whoever dares eavesdrop now will find a flare lying in wait for them

verses.arabicText: وَأَنَّا لَا نَدْرِىٓ أَشَرٌّ أُرِيدَ بِمَن فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ أَمْ أَرَادَ بِهِمْ رَبُّهُمْ رَشَدًا
verses.transliteration: Wa-annā lā nadrī asharrun urīda biman fī l-arḍi am arāda bihim rabbuhum rashadā
verses.translation: Now, we have no clue whether evil is intended for those on earth, or their Lord intends for them what is right

verses.arabicText: وَأَنَّا مِنَّا ٱلصَّـٰلِحُونَ وَمِنَّا دُونَ ذَٰلِكَ ۖ كُنَّا طَرَآئِقَ قِدَدًا
verses.transliteration: Wa-annā minnā ṣ-ṣāliḥūna waminnā dūna dhālika kunnā ṭarāiqa qidadā
verses.translation: Among us are those who are righteous and those who are less so. We have been of different factions

verses.arabicText: وَأَنَّا ظَنَنَّآ أَن لَّن نُّعْجِزَ ٱللَّهَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَن نُّعْجِزَهُۥ هَرَبًا
verses.transliteration: Wa-annā ẓanannā al-lan-nuʿ'jiza l-laha fī l-arḍi walan-nuʿ'jizahu harabā
verses.translation: ˹Now,˺ we truly know that we cannot frustrate Allah on earth, nor can we escape from Him ˹into heaven˺

verses.arabicText: وَأَنَّا لَمَّا سَمِعْنَا ٱلْهُدَىٰٓ ءَامَنَّا بِهِۦ ۖ فَمَن يُؤْمِنۢ بِرَبِّهِۦ فَلَا يَخَافُ بَخْسًا وَلَا رَهَقًا
verses.transliteration: Wa-annā lammā samiʿ'nā l-hudā āmannā bihi famay-yu'min birabbihi falā yakhāfu bakhsaw-walā rahaqā
verses.translation: When we heard the guidance ˹of the Quran˺, we ˹readily˺ believed in it. For whoever believes in their Lord will have no fear of being denied ˹a reward˺ or wronged

verses.arabicText: وَأَنَّا مِنَّا ٱلْمُسْلِمُونَ وَمِنَّا ٱلْقَـٰسِطُونَ ۖ فَمَنْ أَسْلَمَ فَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ تَحَرَّوْا۟ رَشَدًا
verses.transliteration: Wa-annā minnā l-mus'limūna waminnā l-qāsiṭūna faman aslama fa-ulāika taḥarraw rashadā
verses.translation: And among us are those who have submitted ˹to Allah˺ and those who are deviant. So ˹as for˺ those who submitted, it is they who have attained Right Guidance

verses.arabicText: وَأَمَّا ٱلْقَـٰسِطُونَ فَكَانُوا۟ لِجَهَنَّمَ حَطَبًا
verses.transliteration: Wa-ammā l-qāsiṭūna fakānū lijahannama ḥaṭabā
verses.translation: And as for the deviant, they will be fuel for Hell.’”

verses.arabicText: وَأَلَّوِ ٱسْتَقَـٰمُوا۟ عَلَى ٱلطَّرِيقَةِ لَأَسْقَيْنَـٰهُم مَّآءً غَدَقًا
verses.transliteration: Wa-allawi is'taqāmū ʿalā ṭ-ṭarīqati la-asqaynāhum māan ghadaqā
verses.translation: Had the deniers followed the Right Way, We would have certainly granted them abundant rain to drink—

verses.arabicText: لِّنَفْتِنَهُمْ فِيهِ ۚ وَمَن يُعْرِضْ عَن ذِكْرِ رَبِّهِۦ يَسْلُكْهُ عَذَابًا صَعَدًا
verses.transliteration: Linaftinahum fīhi wamay-yuʿ'riḍ ʿan dhik'ri rabbihi yasluk'hu ʿadhāban ṣaʿadā
verses.translation: as a test for them. And whoever turns away from the remembrance of their Lord will be admitted by Him into an overwhelming punishment

verses.arabicText: وَأَنَّ ٱلْمَسَـٰجِدَ لِلَّهِ فَلَا تَدْعُوا۟ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ أَحَدًا
verses.transliteration: Wa-anna l-masājida lillahi falā tadʿū maʿa l-lahi aḥadā
verses.translation: The places of worship are ˹only˺ for Allah, so do not invoke anyone besides Him

verses.arabicText: وَأَنَّهُۥ لَمَّا قَامَ عَبْدُ ٱللَّهِ يَدْعُوهُ كَادُوا۟ يَكُونُونَ عَلَيْهِ لِبَدًا
verses.transliteration: Wa-annahu lammā qāma ʿabdu l-lahi yadʿūhu kādū yakūnūna ʿalayhi libadā
verses.translation: Yet when the servant of Allah stood up calling upon Him ˹alone˺, the pagans almost swarmed over him

verses.arabicText: قُلْ إِنَّمَآ أَدْعُوا۟ رَبِّى وَلَآ أُشْرِكُ بِهِۦٓ أَحَدًا
verses.transliteration: Qul innamā adʿū rabbī walā ush'riku bihi aḥadā
verses.translation: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “I call only upon my Lord, associating none with Him ˹in worship˺.”

verses.arabicText: قُلْ إِنِّى لَآ أَمْلِكُ لَكُمْ ضَرًّا وَلَا رَشَدًا
verses.transliteration: Qul innī lā amliku lakum ḍarraw-walā rashadā
verses.translation: Say, “It is not in my power to harm or benefit you.”

verses.arabicText: قُلْ إِنِّى لَن يُجِيرَنِى مِنَ ٱللَّهِ أَحَدٌ وَلَنْ أَجِدَ مِن دُونِهِۦ مُلْتَحَدًا
verses.transliteration: Qul innī lay-yujīranī mina l-lahi aḥaduw-walan ajida min dūnihi mul'taḥadā
verses.translation: Say, “No one can protect me from Allah ˹if I were to disobey Him˺, nor can I find any refuge other than Him

verses.arabicText: إِلَّا بَلَـٰغًا مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَرِسَـٰلَـٰتِهِۦ ۚ وَمَن يَعْصِ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥ فَإِنَّ لَهُۥ نَارَ جَهَنَّمَ خَـٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ أَبَدًا
verses.transliteration: Illā balāgham-mina l-lahi warisālātihi wamay-yaʿṣi l-laha warasūlahu fa-inna lahu nāra jahannama khālidīna fīhā abadā
verses.translation: ˹My duty is˺ only to convey ˹the truth˺ from Allah and ˹deliver˺ His messages.” And whoever disobeys Allah and His Messenger will certainly be in the Fire of Hell, to stay there for ever and ever

verses.arabicText: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا رَأَوْا۟ مَا يُوعَدُونَ فَسَيَعْلَمُونَ مَنْ أَضْعَفُ نَاصِرًا وَأَقَلُّ عَدَدًا
verses.transliteration: Ḥattā idhā ra-aw mā yūʿadūna fasayaʿlamūna man aḍʿafu nāṣiraw-wa-aqallu ʿadadā
verses.translation: Only when they see what they have been threatened with will they know who is weaker in helpers and inferior in manpower

verses.arabicText: قُلْ إِنْ أَدْرِىٓ أَقَرِيبٌ مَّا تُوعَدُونَ أَمْ يَجْعَلُ لَهُۥ رَبِّىٓ أَمَدًا
verses.transliteration: Qul in adrī aqarībum-mā tūʿadūna am yajʿalu lahu rabbī amadā
verses.translation: Say, “I do not know if what you are promised is near or my Lord has set a distant time for it

verses.arabicText: عَـٰلِمُ ٱلْغَيْبِ فَلَا يُظْهِرُ عَلَىٰ غَيْبِهِۦٓ أَحَدًا
verses.transliteration: ʿālimu l-ghaybi falā yuẓ'hiru ʿalā ghaybihi aḥadā
verses.translation: ˹He is the˺ Knower of the unseen, disclosing none of it to anyone

verses.arabicText: إِلَّا مَنِ ٱرْتَضَىٰ مِن رَّسُولٍ فَإِنَّهُۥ يَسْلُكُ مِنۢ بَيْنِ يَدَيْهِ وَمِنْ خَلْفِهِۦ رَصَدًا
verses.transliteration: Illā mani ir'taḍā mir-rasūlin fa-innahu yasluku min bayni yadayhi wamin khalfihi raṣadā
verses.translation: except messengers of His choice. Then He appoints angel-guards before and behind them

verses.arabicText: لِّيَعْلَمَ أَن قَدْ أَبْلَغُوا۟ رِسَـٰلَـٰتِ رَبِّهِمْ وَأَحَاطَ بِمَا لَدَيْهِمْ وَأَحْصَىٰ كُلَّ شَىْءٍ عَدَدًۢا
verses.transliteration: Liyaʿlama an qad ablaghū risālāti rabbihim wa-aḥāṭa bimā ladayhim wa-aḥṣā kulla shayin ʿadadā
verses.translation: to ensure that the messengers fully deliver the messages of their Lord—though He ˹already˺ knows all about them, and keeps account of everything.”
